description: Synthetic toll account histories for four people at the Crossway Toll Authority (a fictional state authority), generated for reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. All records are synthetic: none was collected from a real website, account or person, and no real anchor data is used (the reviewer confirmed synthetic data is acceptable). Together the four seeds cover 2025-01-06 through 2026-12-30 in America/New_York; evidence/coverage.md reports the month-by-month counts. The manifest seed is dani (fixtures/minimal.json); marisol, theo and priya are loaded with env.load_seed and listed in fixtures/seeds/index.json. Plazas, rates, plates, people, cards and notices are fictional. No real E-ZPass or Tolls by Mail data, rates or assets are used.

sources.description: Seed dani (the manifest seed, fixtures/minimal.json). scripts/generate-seed.cjs opens Dani Reyes's account on 2025-01-06 and replays about 22 months of tolls, top-ups, auto-replenishments, notices, payments, disputes and statements through Crossway's own handlers, ending at the fixture clock (2026-11-02). Random transponder tolls and plate reads come from a fixed-seed PRNG; the current notices and vehicles are scripted. Workflow rules follow the public E-ZPass NY and Tolls by Mail sites; amounts and deadlines are Crossway's own.

provenance.generated_by: deterministic script (fixed-seed PRNG plus scripted story events), replayed through Crossway's own handlers; no model is called at generation time
provenance.language_model_assistance: The generator script, the scripted story lines (vehicle labels, dispute explanations) and the Mail evidence messages in examples/messaging/ were written with AI coding assistance (Claude) and reviewed by the author; the generated records are the script's output, not model output.

sources.description: Seed marisol (fixtures/seeds/marisol/seed.json), loaded with env.load_seed. Marisol Ortega's account opened 2025-02-03, replayed through Crossway's handlers to the clock 2026-03-09 09:00 Eastern. Her auto-replenish Discover expired in 01/2026, two February attempts failed and the account is suspended; her son's Malibu (BRT6618) was sold on 2026-01-20 and is still listed; a Harborline loaner (LNR4410) is on the account as a temporary plate; her sister Ana's Mastercard is on file. Notices: issued, escalated, disputed (submitted), collections, paid and dismissed.

transformations: Authority time is US Eastern (America/New_York rules computed in src/clock.cjs); amounts in cents; IDs stable across resets.
Outgoing Mail notices and spent previews from the generated history are cleared: history counts as delivered.

Each source's parameters.sha256 is the SHA-256 of that seed file as committed; tests/seeds.test.cjs checks it. expected_counts covers the manifest seed (dani) only: records() counts tolls and notices.

Provenance: every record in every seed is synthetic (kind synthetic, 0 real records). The script that generates them and the story text were written with AI coding assistance and are deterministic; rerunning scripts/generate-seed.cjs reproduces each file byte for byte (--check).

Coverage: scripts/coverage-report.cjs counts the represented dates of the loaded seeds (tolls.at, ledger.at, statements.issued_at, notices.issued_at, disputes.submitted_at and decided_at or withdrawn_at, receipts.created_at) in America/New_York over 2025-01-01..2026-12-31 and writes evidence/coverage.md and evidence/coverage.json.

review.notes: Automated checks (validateSeed, ledger reconciliation, notice-to-toll mapping, non-overlapping possession intervals, generator reproduction, date floor, SHA-256, coverage report) do not replace human review of realism and variation. The human read-through of the four seeds by the author (Rohan Pandey) is still pending; until it is done review.status stays pending. README.md (Data) describes what each seed holds.
